commitSize.description: commitSize on which action is executed

createOnly.description:
If true then it will be assumed that all obs don't previously exist and we will create them with no attempt to fetch them to see if they exist.
This will have better performance if it is known beforehand that they don't exist.

mergeOnly.description:
If true then values in the existing record that are not provided by import content
will be ignored. Otherwise they will be overwritten by the new values, including null values.
